description: Multi-Hazard Average Annual Loss in the GHA Region is a hazard data set listed in ICPAC Geoportal (IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Centre), a regional geoportal (GeoNode), published or maintained by ICPAC. GAR Atlas risk results are presented in terms of probabilistic risk metrics. One of them correspond to the average annual loss (AAL) which accounts for a long-term overview of disaster risk by being the expected loss, averaged on an annual basis, that considers the occurrence of small, medium and extreme events. Coverage: Africa (the listing does not name one country). The portal files it under the publisher ICPAC. The portal shows 2019-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-icpac-portal.
